title: Falcons OC Tommy Rees: There's definite benefits to having QB under center

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Falcons OC Tommy Rees: There's definite benefits to having QB under center
sources.description: The Falcons haven't fully committed to Michael Penix as their starting quarterback for the 2026 season at this point, but they gave some hints about how they'll use Penix or any other quarterback on Wednesday.
